name: @pipeworx/mcp-reverb

tools.name: reverb_search
tools.description: Search live Reverb.com listings for musical gear — guitars, amps, pedals, synths, drums, pro audio. Returns asking prices with make, model, year, finish, condition grade and seller, filterable by category, price band, year range, condition, make and region. Prices are what sellers ARE ASKING, not what anything sold for: Reverb retired its public Price Guide, so no realized-sale data is available from this source.

product_type.description: Root category slug, e.g. "electric-guitars", "effects-and-pedals", "amps", "keyboards-and-synths", "drums-and-percussion". Call reverb_categories for the full list.

category.description: Sub-category slug, e.g. "solid-body" — pairs with product_type

condition.description: Condition slug: new, b-stock, mint, excellent, very-good, good, fair, poor, non-functioning, used (used = any non-new grade)

price_min.description: Minimum price, in the currency given by `currency` (default USD)

currency.description: ISO currency for the price filters and returned prices (default USD)

item_region.description: Where the item ships FROM, e.g. "US", "GB", "EUR_EU"

ships_to.description: Country code the item must ship to, e.g. "US"

page.description: 1-based page. Paging past `total_pages` still works — see `total_pages_note`.

tools.name: reverb_listing
tools.description: One Reverb.com listing in full, by listing ID: title, make, model, year, finish, condition, seller description, asking and buyer price, offer/inventory state, categories, photos and shipping rates by region. The price is the seller's asking price on a live listing.

listing_id.description: Reverb listing ID, e.g. 98282577 (the `id` from reverb_search)

tools.name: reverb_shop
tools.description: Reverb.com seller profile by shop slug: shop name, location, feedback count and rating, preferred-seller status, return policy and shipping posture. Answers "who is this seller and what is their track record" for a listing found via reverb_search.

tools.name: reverb_categories
tools.description: The Reverb.com category tree — root product types (electric guitars, effects and pedals, amps, keyboards and synths, drums, pro audio, folk instruments) and their sub-categories, with the slugs and UUIDs used by the product_type and category filters on reverb_search.

root_slug.description: Optional: return only this root category and its children, e.g. "electric-guitars"

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-reverb forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the reverb pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
